title: Python ML: Train/Test
description: Train/Test is a method to measure the accuracy of your model. It is called Train/Test because you split the data set into two sets: a training set (80%) and a testing set (20%). You train the model using the training set and test the model using the testing set to avoid overfitting.
example:
# Train/Test Split Example
import numpy
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

x = numpy.random.normal(3, 1, 100)
y = numpy.random.normal(150, 40, 100) / x

train_x = x[:80]
train_y = y[:80]

test_x = x[80:]
test_y = y[80:]

# Train the model (Polynomial example)
mymodel = numpy.poly1d(numpy.polyfit(train_x, train_y, 4))
r2 = r2_score(train_y, mymodel(train_x))
print(r2) # R-squared should be high for training set
